_comment: One-shot forced tick — read by run-tick.ts `auto` on the NAS (which git-pulls main hourly). Fires ONCE inside [notBeforeUtc, expiresUtc) at the next IDLE hour (a scheduled tick wins its own hour); the done-stamp lives in the container's data/.tmp. To arm a new one: change `key` + the window + mode, commit. An expired file is inert — safe to leave in the repo. 2026-08-27: generate the NEW valuation feeds off-schedule — the forced FULL runs refresh-index-trend + refresh-sector-trend (which didn't exist at the last FULL, so the Macro → Valuation tab is currently blank), plus refresh-real-economy with its deepened ~21yr history for the new detail view. Populates the Valuation tab + the drill-down without waiting for the 23:00 UTC scheduled FULL.
